- Minecraft: `curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh && docker run -d --name mc -e EULA=TRUE -e MEMORY=2G -p 25565:25565 -v /opt/mc:/data --restart unless-stopped itzg/minecraft-server`

Find the BEST-MAINTAINED, currently-working ARK ASE Docker image (verify it exists on Docker Hub / GitHub in 2025-2026; candidates: hermsi/ark-server, and others — pick the most maintained). Then produce:

1. **Docker image** + 1-line why + Docker Hub/GitHub URL (verify it's real/maintained).
2. **setupScript** — the exact `curl … | sh && docker run -d --name ark … <image>` line: correct ARK ports (game 7777/udp, query 27015/udp, RCON 27020 as needed), volume `-v /opt/ark:<container path>`, and sane default env (session name "Nxeon", server/admin password placeholders, map TheIsland, MaxPlayers).
3. **Ports to forward** (list).
4. **game-control**: container name (`ark`), the on-host config file path under the /opt/ark volume (GameUserSettings.ini location), and note config edits need a container restart (`docker restart ark`).
5. **game-config FamilySchema** as a TS object literal matching this shape: `{ family:"ark", label:"ARK: Survival Evolved", defaultVariant:"theisland", variants:[{id,label,description}], fields:[{key,label,group,type:"enum"|"bool"|"int"|"string",default,options?,min?,max?,phase:"deploy"|"live",help?}] }`. Variants = a few maps (TheIsland/TheCenter/Ragnarok/etc). Fields = ~6 real GameUserSettings keys (max players, difficulty/rates like XPMultiplier/TamingSpeedMultiplier/HarvestAmountMultiplier, PvP toggle, day-cycle).
6. **GamePlan tiers** (ARK is RAM-heavy!): 2-3 tiers as objects `{name, ramMB, cpuCores, diskGB, slots, priceCents}` — e.g. 8GB/16GB/32GB, priced higher than Minecraft.
7. **GAME_META**: `{ name:"ARK: Survival Evolved", tag:"Survival · dinosaurs" }`.

```bash
docker run -d \

  -e SERVER_PASSWORD="YouShallNotPass" \

  -p 7778:7778/udp \

  -p 27020:27020/tcp \
  hermsi/ark-server:latest
```

`/app` (configurable via `ARK_SERVER_VOLUME` environment variable)

- `7777/udp`: Game client connections
- `7778/udp`: Raw UDP socket
- `27015/udp`: Server-list/query port

It's the consensus best-maintained ASE image; the older `thmhoag/arkserver` is deprecated. ASA is Windows-only and correctly skipped.

## 1. Docker image
- **`hermsi/ark-server:latest`** — actively rebuilt weekly, uses steamcmd + arkmanager under the hood, fully env-configurable, ASE-native Linux server.
- Docker Hub: https://hub.docker.com/r/hermsi/ark-server
- GitHub: https://github.com/Hermsi1337/docker-ark-server

## 2. setupScript (exact one-liner)
```bash
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh && docker run -d --name ark -e SESSION_NAME="Nxeon" -e SERVER_MAP=TheIsland -e SERVER_PASSWORD="CHANGEME_SERVER" -e ADMIN_PASSWORD="CHANGEME_ADMIN" -e MAX_PLAYERS=20 -p 7777:7777/udp -p 7778:7778/udp -p 27015:27015/udp -p 27020:27020/tcp -v /opt/ark:/app --restart unless-stopped hermsi/ark-server:latest
```
Container volume mount point is `/app` (host `/opt/ark`). Note the extra `-e` block vs. Minecraft/Rust — ARK's session/password/map/players are set through env, matching the image's contract.

## 3. Ports to forward
- **7777/udp** — game client connections (primary)
- **7778/udp** — raw UDP socket (always game port +1, required)
- **27015/udp** — Steam server-list / query
- **27020/tcp** — RCON (open only if remote admin console is used)

## 4. game-control
- **Container name:** `ark`
- **On-host config file** (under the `/opt/ark` volume):
  `/opt/ark/server/ShooterGame/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/GameUserSettings.ini`
  (the entrypoint also symlinks it to the volume root, i.e. `/opt/ark/GameUserSettings.ini` — either path works). `Game.ini` sits alongside it in the same directory.
- **Config edits require a container restart:** `docker restart ark`

## 6. GamePlan tiers (RAM-heavy — priced above Minecraft)
ARK needs ~6 GB minimum for a fresh single map and grows with mods/players, so entry tier starts at 8 GB.
```ts
const arkPlans = [
  { name: "ARK Starter",  ramMB: 8192,  cpuCores: 2, diskGB: 40,  slots: 20, priceCents: 1499 },
  { name: "ARK Standard", ramMB: 16384, cpuCores: 4, diskGB: 80,  slots: 50, priceCents: 2799 },
  { name: "ARK Cluster",  ramMB: 32768, cpuCores: 6, diskGB: 160, slots: 100, priceCents: 4999 },
];
```

## Integration notes
- **Passwords:** ship `SERVER_PASSWORD`/`ADMIN_PASSWORD` as placeholders in the setupScript and inject real per-order secrets at provision time (same pattern as other games' env secrets). Never bake a real admin password into the template.
- **Map switching** = redeploy: `SERVER_MAP` is a container env, so changing the variant requires re-running `docker run` (deploy-phase), not a live restart. Persistent saves survive in `/opt/ark` across recreation.
- **First boot is slow:** the image downloads the full ARK server via steamcmd on first start (several GB), so provisioning UX should show a "installing, may take 10-20 min" state before the server is joinable.
- **Disk:** ARK installs are large (~20 GB+ before saves); the 40 GB floor on the Starter tier accounts for that plus growth.
